CAN-CONTRACT-GOV-001.evidence: governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
CAN-CONTRACT-GOV-001.reason: The agreement specifies Delaware law and venue in Delaware rather than a Canadian jurisdiction with venue in Canada.

CAN-CONTRACT-LIAB-001.evidence: The parties' respective liabilities shall be determined under applicable law.
CAN-CONTRACT-LIAB-001.reason: The contract contains no quantified cap on aggregate liability tied to fees or any defined period.

CAN-CONTRACT-PAY-001.reason: The contract requires payment within 45 days, exceeding the rule’s maximum of net 30 days from receipt of an undisputed invoice.

CAN-CONTRACT-PRIVACY-001.evidence: process Personal Data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
CAN-CONTRACT-PRIVACY-001.reason: The contract processes personal data but references GDPR instead of PIPEDA or similar Canadian privacy legislation.

CAN-CONTRACT-TERM-001.evidence: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material uncured breach upon thirty (30) days' written notice.
CAN-CONTRACT-TERM-001.reason: The document includes termination for cause but does not include a termination-for-convenience clause with a defined notice period.
